name: Talladega Wild Basil
desc: Talladega Wild Basil (Clinopodium talladeganum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 47 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Clinopodium talladeganum, commonly known as the Talladega wild basil, is a perennial vascular shrub in the mint family. C. talladeganum is endemic to a small area in three counties of Alabama.
